interaction.prompt: You are the center. Your D is retrieving the puck under heavy forecheck pressure. Tap where you should go to support.

feedback.right: Curl low into the strong-side circle and stay underneath the puck. You give your D a short, safe ten-foot outlet they can actually make.
feedback.wrong: Flying the zone early to the far blue line looks like a quick counterattack, but your D is squeezed by two forecheckers with no clean long lane. Leaving the support layer hangs them out to dry.

tip: Read your D before you take off. If they are getting squeezed, come low and show your blade.
why: Reading the defenseman's pressure before bolting up ice keeps a short outlet available, so the breakout starts with a completion instead of a forced long pass.
